product: Editing files in Unity Catalog volumes is now generally available
tagline: You can now edit files in Unity Catalog volumes directly in the workspace file editor, without downloading and uploading them again.
what_it_does: You can now edit files in Unity Catalog volumes directly in the workspace file editor, without downloading and uploading them again. Open a file from Catalog Explorer or from the schema browser in a notebook or the SQL editor. This page has examples for managing files in Unity Catalog volumes for various user interfaces, tools, libraries, and languages.
why_it_matters: This can improve performance for iterative algorithms and complex query plans by preventing excessively long lineages when reusing DataFrames.
